thread:
Elena: Following up on the all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses  want to capture concrete asks and owners here.
Marco: Quick summary from the session: wins = Dedicated SLA clarity + predictable latency; losses = Private onboarding friction and cost surprises.
Priya: Re: Private onboarding  customers want a short validation checklist for network + KMS. Right now it takes too many handoffs.
Jun: I'll draft a 1-page Nginx+VPC example and a KMS smoke test script we can drop into docs.
Sam: Do we have data showing whether cost vs quality is the main loss reason for SMB/mid-market?
Priya: Short answer: cost. Enterprise losses trend to security/SLA. We had three mid-market losses last quarter that called out unit cost specifically.
Ava: Can we make a 1-page "ask -> owner -> ETA" for CS to hand prospects? Must include p50/p95 ranges so GTM can set expectations.
Marco: I'll own the one-pager. ETA: 2w. Will include: Dedicated SLA highlights, Private quickstart links, perf p50/p95 by common models, and common cost-saving knobs (batching, quant).
Jun: I can provide a redacted hosted->Dedicated case showing ~40% per-token cost reduction for the 1-pager.
Sam: On roadmap: customers asked for scripts AND a console-guided flow. Which comes first?
Marco: Short term: scripts/templates (2w). Mid-term: console guided deploy (Q2).
Ava: Suggestion: add a CRM "lost-deal" tag that auto-triggers a short postmortem (1-pager) and routes to Product weekly. Rev Ops can own automation.
Priya: Sarah from Rev Ops already volunteered to wire the automation.
Elena: Action items summary: Marco = one-pager (2w), Jun = redacted case (1w), Docs = Private quickstart + snippets (owner: docs team, 2w), Rev Ops/Sarah = CRM -> postmortem automation.
Sam: Please include a tiny decision checklist on model variant tradeoffs (latency vs quality vs cost) for CS to use in conversations.
Jun: I'll add a 3-line checklist to the one-pager.
Ava: GTM can do a quick review in 24-48h if tagged.
ops-bot: Task created: #4691 "All-hands customer action one-pager" assigned to Marco. Due 2026-04-08.
Elena: Thanks all  treating this thread as canonical for follow-ups; will report progress next all-hands.
